title.zh: COOLINKEY CLX 智能指纹链条锁

subtitle.en: IP67 dust and water resistance · Bluetooth 5.0 · Up to 60 fingerprints · About 10 months of typical use per charge (400 mAh, USB-C). Zinc alloy body; stainless steel chain in a PET-wrapped textile sleeve (~100 cm). Works with the Tuya Smart app for access sharing and history.
subtitle.zh: IP67 防尘防水 · 蓝牙 5.0 · 最多 60 枚指纹 · 400 mAh 电池、Type-C 充电，典型使用约 10 个月续航。锌合金锁体；不锈钢链芯外包耐磨 PET 织物套管，链长约 100 cm。配合涂鸦智能 App 管理授权与记录。

text.en: Park at racks, poles, or communal stands without fumbling for keys. Matte black body, recessed fingerprint pad, and a sleeved chain read as premium gear—because your lock should look as intentional as your bike.
text.zh: 在停车架、立柱或小区车棚快速落锁，告别掏钥匙。哑光黑锁体、内凹式指纹区与织物包覆链条，与高端公路车气质一致——锁具本身也应是装备的一部分。

text.en: Rain, splashes, and roadside grime are part of the ride. CLX1/CLX2 are built for outdoor duty so you can focus on the route—not the weather forecast.
text.zh: 雨水、溅水与路面泥尘都是骑行日常。CLX1/CLX2 面向户外使用设计，让你更关注路线，而不是反复查看天气预报。

text.en: IP67 sealing helps keep dust and water out of the electronics. Bluetooth 5.0 keeps pairing stable in busy signal environments. Use this module for lab sheets, drop-test photos, or short verification videos.
text.zh: IP67 结构有助于阻隔粉尘与水汽侵入电子腔体；蓝牙 5.0 在复杂无线环境下保持连接稳定。本模块适合放实验室报告、跌落/防水示意照片或短视频。

text.en: Zinc alloy housing, stainless steel chain, nylon and PET in the sleeve—chosen for strength, wear resistance, and a clean silhouette. Replace this slide with factory line photos or macro shots of the lock body and chain.
text.zh: 锌合金外壳、不锈钢链条、尼龙与 PET 织物层——兼顾强度、耐磨与简洁外观。可将本图替换为产线实拍、锁体与链条的特写等。

description.en: Sealed against dust and immersion-grade water ingress so outdoor parking stays practical year-round.
description.zh: 防尘防水设计，适应户外停车与多变天气，四季使用更安心。

description.en: Register up to 60 fingerprints; unlock on the pad without reaching for keys or your phone.
description.zh: 最多支持 60 枚指纹；在锁体面板上直接解锁，无需翻找钥匙或手机。

description.en: Stainless steel links inside a PET-wrapped textile sleeve—about 100 cm to wrap frame, wheel, and anchor point.
description.zh: 不锈钢链芯外包耐磨织物套管，链长约 100 cm，可环绕车架、轮组与固定物。

body.en: COOLINKEY builds smart security for bicycles and daily carry—combining fingerprint access, a tough sleeved chain, and app connectivity so you can lock up quickly and get back to riding.
body.zh: COOLINKEY 专注自行车与随身场景的智能安防，将指纹解锁、高强度包覆链条与 App 互联结合，让你快速上锁、回到骑行与都市生活。

body.en: For support, distribution, or business inquiries: support@coolinkey.com
